title: HBO Intro - Behind the Scenes
summary: A 1983 behind-the-scenes film about making the HBO 'Feature Presentation' starship logo sequence. It shows the handcrafted miniature city, motion-control cameras and practical effects.
why: HN recommends it as a look at pre-CGI effects work that looks like CGI but was entirely physical.

quote.text: looks CGI but is entirely physical models, motion controlled cameras, and clever compositing
